item.name: Ladybug
item.location: Mushroom Field, Clover Field, and Strawberry Field.
item.levelOrHp: 12 HP at level 1, 20 HP at level 2, and 28 HP at level 3.
item.spawnOrRespawn: Respawns in about 5 minutes, or 4 minutes 15 seconds with Gifted Vicious Bee.
item.attacks: Deals 15 damage.
item.drops: About 75 Honey; Tickets have a small chance to drop.
item.accessCondition: Fight it in Mushroom Field, Clover Field, or Strawberry Field.
item.cardSummary: Ladybug is a field mob found in Mushroom Field, Clover Field, and Strawberry Field.

item.name: Rhino Beetle
item.location: Clover Field, Blue Flower Field, Bamboo Field, and Pineapple Patch.
item.spawnOrRespawn: Respawns in about 5 minutes, or 4 minutes 15 seconds with the Vicious Bee hive bonus.
item.attacks: Deals 18 damage.
item.drops: About 75 Honey; Snowflakes can appear during Beesmas.
item.accessCondition: Fight it in Clover Field, Blue Flower Field, Bamboo Field, or Pineapple Patch.
item.cardSummary: Rhino Beetle is a field mob found in Clover Field, Blue Flower Field, Bamboo Field, and Pineapple Patch.

item.name: Spider
item.location: Spider Field.
item.spawnOrRespawn: Respawns in about 30 minutes, or 25 minutes 30 seconds with Gifted Vicious Bee.
item.attacks: Deals 20 damage.
item.accessCondition: Fight it in Spider Field.
item.cardSummary: Spider is a field mob found in Spider Field.

item.name: Mantis
item.location: Pineapple Patch and Pine Tree Forest.
item.spawnOrRespawn: Respawns in about 20 minutes, or 17 minutes with Gifted Vicious Bee.
item.attacks: Deals 20 damage.
item.accessCondition: Fight it in Pineapple Patch or Pine Tree Forest.
item.cardSummary: Mantis is a field mob found in Pineapple Patch and Pine Tree Forest.

item.name: Werewolf
item.location: Cactus Field and Pumpkin Patch.
item.spawnOrRespawn: Respawns in about 1 hour, or 51 minutes with Gifted Vicious Bee.
item.attacks: Deals 35 damage.
item.accessCondition: Fight it in Cactus Field or Pumpkin Patch.
item.cardSummary: Werewolf is a field mob found in Cactus Field and Pumpkin Patch.

item.name: Scorpion
item.location: Rose Field.
item.spawnOrRespawn: Respawns in about 20 minutes, or 17 minutes with Gifted Vicious Bee.
item.attacks: Deals 25 damage.
item.accessCondition: Fight it in Rose Field.
item.cardSummary: Scorpion is a field mob found in Rose Field.

item.name: King Beetle
item.location: King Beetle's Lair.
item.spawnOrRespawn: Respawns in about 24 hours, or 20 hours 24 minutes with Gifted Vicious Bee.
item.attacks: Deals 40 damage per hit.
item.drops: 500 Bond, 1,000,000 Honey, and 100 Treats on the first defeat.
item.accessCondition: Fight it in King Beetle's Lair.
item.cardSummary: King Beetle is a field mob found in King Beetle's Lair.

item.name: Cave Monster
item.location: Inside Werewolf's Cave.
item.attacks: Moves very quickly and can be difficult for slower bees to reach.
item.drops: A Honey Bee Egg can drop.
item.accessCondition: Fight it inside Werewolf's Cave.
item.cardSummary: Cave Monster is a field mob found in Inside Werewolf's Cave.

item.name: Tunnel Bear
item.location: White Tunnel.
item.spawnOrRespawn: Respawns in about 48 hours, or 40 hours 48 minutes with Gifted Vicious Bee.
item.attacks: Deals 1,000 damage and can instantly defeat players who get too close.
item.drops: 1,000 Bond and 5,000,000 Honey on the first defeat.
item.accessCondition: Fight it in White Tunnel.
item.cardSummary: Tunnel Bear is a boss or field encounter found in White Tunnel.

item.name: Stump Snail
item.location: Stump Field.
item.spawnOrRespawn: Respawns in about 96 hours, or 81.6 hours with Gifted Vicious Bee.
item.attacks: Deals 30 contact damage and moves around the field.
item.drops: Shell Amulet, Honey, Glue, and Star Jelly.
item.accessCondition: Fight it in Stump Field.
item.cardSummary: Stump Snail is a boss or field encounter found in Stump Field.

item.name: Coconut Crab
item.location: Coconut Field.
item.spawnOrRespawn: Respawns in about 36 hours, or 30.6 hours with Gifted Vicious Bee.
item.attacks: Uses claw, coconut, and contact attacks; the fight has a two-hour defeat window.
item.accessCondition: Fight it in Coconut Field.
item.cardSummary: Coconut Crab is a boss or field encounter found in Coconut Field.

item.name: Aphid
item.location: Leaves in most fields except Ant Field, Hub Field, and Stump Field.
item.attacks: Damage varies by type; follows the nearest player slowly.
item.accessCondition: Fight it in leaves across most fields, except Ant Field, Hub Field, and Stump Field.
item.cardSummary: Aphid is a field mob found in Leaves in most fields except Ant Field, Hub Field, and Stump Field.

item.name: Rogue Vicious Bee
item.location: Clover Field, Spider Field, Cactus Field, Rose Field, Mountain Top Field, and Pepper Patch.
item.levelOrHp: HP increases with level and gifted status; levels 1-12.
item.attacks: Deals 40 damage normally or 50 when gifted; attacks when players approach its spike.
item.accessCondition: Fight it in Clover Field, Spider Field, Cactus Field, Rose Field, Mountain Top Field, or Pepper Patch.
item.cardSummary: Rogue Vicious Bee is a rare or quest encounter found in Clover Field, Spider Field, Cactus Field, Rose Field, Mountain Top Field, and Pepper Patch.

item.name: Wild Windy Bee
item.location: All fields except Stump Field, Ant Field, and Hive Hub.
item.spawnOrRespawn: Spawns in Dandelion Field, Pineapple Patch, Pumpkin Patch, Mountain Top Field, or Coconut Field.
item.attacks: Deals contact damage and grows stronger with defeats and proximity to its tornado.
item.accessCondition: Fight it in an eligible field outside Stump Field, Ant Field, and Hive Hub.
item.cardSummary: Wild Windy Bee is a rare or quest encounter found in All fields except Stump Field, Ant Field, and Hive Hub.

item.name: Stick Bug
item.location: On top of the tallest mushroom in Mushroom Field.
item.attacks: Damage increases by level.
item.accessCondition: Fight it on the tallest mushroom in Mushroom Field.
item.cardSummary: Stick Bug is a rare or quest encounter found in On top of the tallest mushroom in Mushroom Field.

item.name: Stick Nymph
item.attacks: Follows the nearest player and deals damage on contact.
item.cardSummary: Stick Nymph is a rare or quest encounter.

item.name: Commando Chick
item.location: Commando Chick's Hideout.
item.levelOrHp: HP scales with captures, from 150 to 10,000,000; levels 3-25.
item.spawnOrRespawn: Respawns in about 30 minutes, or 25 minutes 30 seconds with the Gifted Vicious Bee hive bonus.
item.attacks: Deals 20 collision damage and 50 grenade damage; its shell blocks attacks.
item.accessCondition: Fight it in Commando Chick's Hideout.
item.cardSummary: Commando Chick is a rare or quest encounter found in Commando Chick's Hideout.

item.name: Mondo Chick
item.location: Mountain Top Field.
item.spawnOrRespawn: Respawns in about 45 minutes to 1 hour.
item.attacks: Deals 75 damage and loses health automatically during the fight.
item.accessCondition: Fight it in Mountain Top Field.
item.cardSummary: Mondo Chick is a rare or quest encounter found in Mountain Top Field.

item.name: Ant
item.location: Ant Field during the Ant Challenge.
item.levelOrHp: 25 base HP; increases by wave level.
item.attacks: Deals 40 damage and moves in a straight line.
item.accessCondition: Appears in Ant Field during the Ant Challenge.
item.cardSummary: Ant is an ant challenge enemy found in Ant Field during the Ant Challenge.

item.name: Army Ant
item.location: Ant Field during the Ant Challenge.
item.levelOrHp: 50 base HP; increases by wave level.
item.attacks: Deals 40 damage and takes reduced damage because of its defense.
item.accessCondition: Appears in Ant Field during the Ant Challenge.
item.cardSummary: Army Ant is an ant challenge enemy found in Ant Field during the Ant Challenge.

item.name: Flying Ant
item.location: Ant Field during the Ant Challenge.
item.attacks: Deals 40 damage and moves quickly.
item.accessCondition: Appears in Ant Field during the Ant Challenge.
item.cardSummary: Flying Ant is an ant challenge enemy found in Ant Field during the Ant Challenge.

item.name: Giant Ant
item.location: Ant Field during the Ant Challenge.
item.attacks: Deals 60 damage and moves slowly but has high health and attack.
item.accessCondition: Appears in Ant Field during the Ant Challenge.
item.cardSummary: Giant Ant is an ant challenge enemy found in Ant Field during the Ant Challenge.

item.name: Fire Ant
item.location: Ant Field during the Ant Challenge.
item.levelOrHp: 25 base HP; increases by wave level.
item.attacks: Deals 30 flame-trail damage and 40 contact damage.
item.accessCondition: Appears in Ant Field during the Ant Challenge.
item.cardSummary: Fire Ant is an ant challenge enemy found in Ant Field during the Ant Challenge.

item.name: Mechsquito
item.location: Anywhere during Robo Bear Challenge, including outside fields.
item.levelOrHp: HP increases with challenge level and round.
item.attacks: Deals 5 laser damage and 25 contact damage; hovers away before firing a projectile.
item.accessCondition: Appears during Robo Bear Challenge, including outside fields.
item.cardSummary: Mechsquito is a robo bear challenge enemy found in Anywhere during Robo Bear Challenge, including outside fields.

item.name: Cogmower
item.location: Any field during Robo Bear Challenge.
item.levelOrHp: HP increases with challenge level and round; levels 5-22.
item.attacks: Deals 50 damage that increases with level and takes half damage from Critical Hits.
item.accessCondition: Appears during Robo Bear Challenge in any field.
item.cardSummary: Cogmower is a robo bear challenge enemy found in Any field during Robo Bear Challenge.

item.name: Cogturret
item.location: Any field during Robo Bear Challenge.
item.levelOrHp: HP increases with challenge level and round; levels 11-22.
item.attacks: Deals 25 Red Cog damage and 34 contact damage; hides under the field before attacking.
item.accessCondition: Appears during Robo Bear Challenge in any field.
item.cardSummary: Cogturret is a robo bear challenge enemy found in Any field during Robo Bear Challenge.

item.name: Mega Mechsquito
item.location: Any field during Robo Bear Challenge.
item.levelOrHp: HP increases with challenge level and round; levels 13-22.
item.attacks: Deals 4 laser damage and 30 contact damage; fires small exploding projectiles from a distance.
item.accessCondition: Appears during Robo Bear Challenge in any field.
item.cardSummary: Mega Mechsquito is a robo bear challenge enemy found in Any field during Robo Bear Challenge.

item.name: Golden Cogmower
item.location: Clover Field, Pineapple Patch, Pumpkin Patch, or Mountain Top Field during Robo Bear Challenge.
item.levelOrHp: HP increases with challenge level and round; levels 6-22.
item.attacks: Deals 50-75 damage and takes half damage from Critical Hits.
item.accessCondition: Appears during Robo Bear Challenge in Clover Field, Pineapple Patch, Pumpkin Patch, or Mountain Top Field.
item.cardSummary: Golden Cogmower is a robo bear challenge enemy found in Clover Field, Pineapple Patch, Pumpkin Patch, or Mountain Top Field during Robo Bear Challenge.
